extracted.name: Spicy Mango Sauce
extracted.description: Try this bright, delightful, spicy mango sauce over grilled fish.
ingredient_lines: 1 teaspoon hot chile paste (such as sambal oelek)
instruction_lines: Combine mango, rice wine vinegar, lime juice, garlic, hot chili paste, and Thai chile pepper in a bowl. Cover and let rest 30 minutes. Stir in cilantro.
